rules: Off-screen ships and facilities continue existing and operating at appropriate simulation LOD.
A ship cannot arrive before valid travel time elapses.
Maintenance, resupply and repair consume time/capacity/resources.
Routine simulation may aggregate uneventful work but major damage, death, refit, mission completion or route diversion requires explicit event records.
LOD reduction does not make facilities infinite-capacity or ships immune to logistics.
Returning to high LOD restores from accumulated state rather than rerolling.
